paragraphs.text: I am an engineer specializing in the coordination and monitoring of engineering projects, currently looking for a full-time position to expand my skillset.
Home Address: 2179 Clover Avenue, Coquitlam, British Columbia V3J 5S9
Ensures compliance to safety and performance standards Conducts quality control checks Schedules, coordinates and monitors engineering projects
Evaluates, hires and trains junior engineers
Prepares monthly performance reports Develops system upgrades
Completed a postgraduate degree in project engineering; GWA 3.75 Authored a dissertation on "Engineering the Future: Methods in Project Management"
Completed an undergraduate degree in civil engineering; GWA 3.56
Graduated with distinction, with a special award for Best Thesis NCC Scholarship Holder
